description.value:
Cost 2 Encore

Traits Signal

You spend 2 Encore and choose one creature you can perceive in range. You learn which of its saving throws is highest and which is lowest, and you are told both exact modifiers. If two are tied, you are told both. This is not a check and cannot fail; the GM tells you the numbers.

cinderfall.incomplete: P11 — Encore-cost-gated (SB1); payload is a GM-told fact, not a modifiable stat. No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either.
